description: Pins the id, label and enum rules, the at-least-one-field sentence both languages now answer, the config-update PUT body, and the preview that reads the profile being changed.

cases.name: rejects non-positive config_id
cases.expect_error: config_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects non-positive linode_id
cases.expect_error: linode_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a call naming no field to change
cases.expect_error: at least one configuration field must be provided

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This updates a configuration profile on the instance. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects an invalid run_level (proto ConfigRunLevel enum)
cases.expect_error: run_level must be one of: default, single, binbash

cases.name: rejects an invalid virt_mode (proto ConfigVirtMode enum)
cases.expect_error: virt_mode must be one of: paravirt, fullvirt

cases.name: rejects a whitespace-padded label
cases.expect_error: label must not include leading or trailing whitespace

cases.name: rejects an invalid device slot
cases.expect_error: device slot sdz must be one of sda through sdh

cases.name: rejects an empty devices object
cases.expect_error: devices must include at least one device slot

side_effects: Configuration profile 7 on Linode 123 will be updated.
